_comment: verify scenarios for the SSE relay demo (Sky.Core.Http.Stream.forEachChunk, #373). /upstream emits 5 tick + 1 done event over ~1s. /relay opens that upstream stream from within a plain Sky.Http.Server handler goroutine, forEach-drains it synchronously, and re-emits each chunk back through Sky.Http.Server.Stream.emit — chunk-for-chunk. Both endpoints share the same SSE wire shape; the relay just proves the synchronous-iterator bridge.
